description: Default deterministic gates applied to every brief. A brief's own `gates` object overrides keys here. A bare number means the same kind (max or min) as the default gate; an object carries max and/or min; whenLang restricts a gate to briefs of that language. Every gate reads metrics.json aggregate.<name> first and source.<name> second; a metric the render did not produce fails closed as MISSING_METRIC. Font-family count remains diagnostic; color roles and content fit replace universal aesthetic quotas.
